description: Point-in-time query performance: live activity, pg_stat_statements top-N, database health and index coverage. Companion to DB Size & Retention. How to read it: docs/postgres-query-performance.md.

panels.description: Live client-backend counts from pg_stat_activity (autovacuum, parallel and WAL workers excluded). idle_in_txn holds locks and blocks vacuum; waiting_on_lock is contention right now; client_backends_pct is client backends over max_connections.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active') AS active, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle') AS idle, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_txn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock') AS waiting_on_lock, round(100.0 * count(*) / current_setting('max_connections')::int, 1) AS client_backends_pct, current_setting('max_connections')::int AS max_connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'

panels.title: Backends

panels.description: Client backends whose current statement started more than 2 s ago, oldest first. Includes 'idle in transaction' sessions on purpose: for those, age_s is time since their last statement, and a long idle transaction blocks vacuum. Text cut at 120 characters. Empty is the normal state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, usename AS role, COALESCE(NULLIF(application_name, ''), '-') AS app, COALESCE(host(client_addr), 'local') AS client, state, COALESCE(wait_event_type || ':' || wait_event, '-') AS wait, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - query_start))::numeric, 1) AS age_s, left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND state <> 'idle' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND now() - query_start > interval '2 seconds' ORDER BY query_start

panels.title: Statements running longer than 2 s

panels.description: Sessions waiting on a lock held by another session (pg_blocking_pids). blocked_by lists the holder pids; find them in the panel above. Empty is the normal state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.pid, array_to_string(pg_blocking_pids(a.pid), ',') AS blocked_by, a.usename AS role, COALESCE(a.wait_event_type || ':' || a.wait_event, '-') AS wait, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.query_start))::numeric, 1) AS age_s, left(regexp_replace(a.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity a WHERE cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(a.pid)) > 0 ORDER BY a.query_start

panels.title: Blocked sessions

panels.description: Where the database spends its time. s_per_day normalises by days since reset. Cumulative since the pg_stat_statements reset shown in the Health row; entries can be evicted; statements cancelled before completion (Grafana timeouts) never appear here, see docs/postgres-query-performance.md for the log recipe. Rows group parameter-count variants of one query; stddev_ms is the max over variants; utility statements and this dashboard's own queries are excluded.

targets.rawSql: WITH info AS ( SELECT GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - stats_reset)) / 86400, 1.0 / 24) AS days FROM pg_stat_statements_info ), s AS ( SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(query, '\$\d+', '?', 'g'), 'IN \((\?, )*\?\)', 'IN (...)', 'g'), ' VALUES \(.*', ' VALUES (...)') AS family, userid, calls, total_exec_time, max_exec_time, stddev_exec_time, rows, shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read, blk_read_time, temp_blks_read, temp_blks_written FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AND query !~* '^\s*(SAVEPOINT|RELEASE|ROLLBACK|BEGIN|COMMIT|SET |SHOW |DEALLOCATE|DISCARD)' AND query !~ 'pg_stat_|pg_statio_|pg_blocking_pids|pg_constraint' ) SELECT count(*) AS variants, sum(calls) AS calls, round(sum(total_exec_time)::numeric / 1000, 1) AS total_s, round((sum(total_exec_time) / 1000 / (SELECT days FROM info))::numeric, 1) AS s_per_day, round((sum(total_exec_time) / NULLIF(sum(calls), 0))::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms, round(max(max_exec_time)::numeric, 1) AS max_ms, round(max(stddev_exec_time)::numeric, 1) AS stddev_ms, round(sum(rows)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(calls), 0), 1) AS rows_per_call, round(100.0 * sum(shared_blks_hit) / NULLIF(sum(shared_blks_hit) + sum(shared_blks_read), 0), 1) AS hit_pct, round(sum(blk_read_time)::numeric / 1000, 1) AS io_read_s, pg_size_pretty(sum(temp_blks_written) * current_setting('block_size')::bigint) AS temp_written, string_agg(DISTINCT userid::regrole::text, ',') AS role, left(regexp_replace(family, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120) AS query FROM s GROUP BY family ORDER BY sum(total_exec_time) DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Time spent waiting for blocks from disk (needs track_io_timing=on; reads 0 on dev). High stddev_ms plus high io_share_pct is the cold-cache signature: the plan is fine, the pages are not in memory. Cumulative since the pg_stat_statements reset shown in the Health row; entries can be evicted; statements cancelled before completion (Grafana timeouts) never appear here, see docs/postgres-query-performance.md for the log recipe. Rows group parameter-count variants of one query; stddev_ms is the max over variants; utility statements and this dashboard's own queries are excluded.
